launch_policy.publication_cadence: After launch, publish at most one completed article or blog per day. Each must pass the research, citation, content, SEO, and AI-language checks; the production deploy fails if it does not.
launch_policy.editorial_backlog: data/launch-content-plan.json keeps the 10 articles and 10 blogs with tracker-approved URLs as the editorial plan. It is not a launch requirement and drafts never block a release.
